prompt: I'm starting a new project to migrate our CI/CD from Jenkins to Konflux. The goal is to have all repos migrated by end of Q3 2026. Can you set this up in my PARA notes?

assertions.name: Creates project directory structure
assertions.description: Should create 01_Projects/{project-name}/ with Sessions/ and Resources/ subdirectories

assertions.name: Creates README.md with project details
assertions.description: README should include goal, timeline (Q3 2026 deadline), status, and deliverables

assertions.name: Creates Lessons_Learned.md
assertions.description: Should create empty Lessons_Learned.md ready for future discoveries

assertions.name: Updates Home.md
assertions.description: Should add wikilink to new project in Home.md

assertions.name: Uses proper frontmatter
assertions.description: README should have frontmatter with title, status: active, start_date, deadline, tags

assertions.name: Follows PARA structure
assertions.description: Project should be in 01_Projects/ following the PARA organizational method
